page.notes: Printed running head and page number read as shown. Catchword "tur" and signature "L 5" read at the foot. Words at line ends are joined only where the printed hyphen stands (effe-ctus, vo-luntate, con-sequentiae, quan-dam, eam-que, superna-turalium, supernatura-les, afoblu-te, incline-tur). Doubtful readings: "afoblu-te" (may be a printing variant for absolute; copied as seen); the margin references "grat.l.3, 4, & 17.f.4." and "præfc. de au-" (not clearly legible; left as seen, the reference "præfc." is doubtful); the note "Suar. in 6." beside "convictus" is uncertain. The position of the margin references is approximate; those in the right margin are placed beside the text lines they stand next to.
